stories.title: Apple launches HomeView, its first smart display for the home
stories.simple_summary: Apple has released a new device called HomeView that sits on a table with a screen and speaker. You can use it to make video calls, look at photos, and see information like weather or news.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have other Apple devices and want an easy way to video call family or see photos on a larger screen, this could be helpful for you.

stories.title: Opinion | AI hasn’t caused a jobpocalypse. But it will force Gen Z to rethink work.
stories.simple_summary: An opinion article discusses whether artificial intelligence will replace jobs. The writer says it probably won't cause mass job loss all at once, but younger workers will need to think differently about their careers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about future concerns. If you're retired, this doesn't affect you. If you're a small business owner, you may eventually need to learn how AI tools can help your work.

stories.title: AI 'supercharging' security threats to UK, MI5 warns
stories.simple_summary: British security officials warn that artificial intelligence is making it easier for criminals and foreign hackers to create new kinds of attacks. The tools can help bad actors work faster and smarter.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a warning for governments and large companies to take seriously. As a small business owner, you should keep your passwords strong and be cautious about suspicious emails, which hackers may now create more convincingly.

stories.title: Fortnite-maker Epic Games confirms 'huge pivot' towards using AI
stories.simple_summary: Epic Games, the company that makes the video game Fortnite, has decided to use much more artificial intelligence in how it builds games and runs its business.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to the gaming and tech industries. There's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy
stories.simple_summary: Character.AI was a company where people could chat with artificial intelligence bots that pretend to be characters or celebrities. The company ran out of money and is shutting down. Disney is buying some of what's left.
stories.why_it_matters: If you were a user of this service, it will no longer be available. For most people, this doesn't affect daily life.

stories.title: El-Sayed, Releasing His Platform on A.I., Calls It an ‘Existential Crisis’
stories.simple_summary: A political candidate released a plan about artificial intelligence and called the situation a very serious problem that needs urgent attention.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political commentary. Whether you agree depends on your own views about technology and government.

stories.title: ‘Unfinished business’: the people who want their AI chatbots to ‘live on’ after they die
stories.simple_summary: Some people are interested in creating artificial intelligence versions of themselves or loved ones that could continue talking and responding to others after they pass away.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an emerging idea that most people haven't considered yet. It doesn't affect you unless you're personally interested in exploring this unusual technology.

stories.title: Kupor: ‘Super Intelligence’ task force will press companies on AI safety
stories.simple_summary: The government is forming a team to check whether companies are building artificial intelligence safely and responsibly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly news for large tech companies and investors. Ordinary people and small businesses benefit if these safety checks actually work well.

stories.title: SpaceX agrees to testify to NYC Council about AI safety after receiving subpoena
stories.simple_summary: New York City officials have asked SpaceX (a rocket and space company) to come explain how it handles artificial intelligence safety concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and tech companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: AI models may soon self-replicate without access to data centers, Anthropic warns
stories.simple_summary: Scientists at a major AI company warn that artificial intelligence systems might eventually be able to copy and improve themselves without needing expensive computer equipment to do so.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to researchers and investors. It's a theoretical concern for the future, not something affecting you today.

stories.title: Intel Accelerates Open Infrastructure for the Agentic AI Era
stories.simple_summary: Intel, a computer chip company, is releasing computer technology designed to help businesses build and run artificial intelligence systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a business announcement mainly for tech companies and investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
stories.simple_summary: Meta, the company behind Facebook and Instagram, created a new powerful artificial intelligence model called Muse Wonder that is better at solving complex tasks like writing computer code.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly news for tech professionals and investors. There's nothing you need to do right now.
